args.command:
cd /office; python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv
d={r['站']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('inbox/06-06/委托.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
obj={'J01':('HZ-A','东港'),'J02':('JL-B','东港'),'J03':('NP-B','东港'),'J04':('HZ-B','西湾'),
'J05':('YC-A','西湾'),'J06':('QH-B','西湾'),'J07':('JL-A','南站'),'J08':('BA-B','南站'),
'J09':('QH-A','南站'),'J10':('NP-A','北仓'),'J11':('YC-B','北仓'),'J12':('BA-A','北仓')}
rows=[]
for k in sorted(obj):
    code,st=obj[k]; ser=code.split('-')[1]
    v=d[st]
    cover = '是' if ser in v['代办系列'] else '否(系列不符)'
    rows.append([k,v['代办系列'],v['末日']])
    print(k,code,st,'本站代办系列',v['代办系列'],f"({v['开始']}-{v['末日']})",'本案系列',ser,'覆盖',cover)
with open('out/委托.csv','w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\r\n'); w.writerow(['案号','本站代办系列','本站代办末日']); w.writerows(rows)
print(open('out/委托.csv').read())
EOF
